goals: Simic ramp that abuses extra land drops to draw the deck off Aesi, then buries the table under landfall payoffs and giant sea monsters.
constraints: No intentional early-game two-card infinite combos (bracket 3).
At most 3 Game Changers (bracket 3); currently 2: Cyclonic Rift, Rhystic Study.
preferences: Prefer cards that either grant extra land drops, trigger on landfall, or convert lands into cards.
